instruction: Enable automatic cloud synchronization for this document so that changes are saved to Google Drive in real-time.

metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer does not have native real-time cloud synchronization features. While LibreOffice can work with cloud storage through external tools, automatic real-time sync to cloud services like Google Drive is not a built-in feature.
